notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Tanazir.
description:
Activate Tanazir by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Tanazir enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Tanazir trigger, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
